posts.trend: UPI MDR For Capital Markets: Why A Tiny Fee Could Test India’s Zero-brokerage Model
posts.context: The middle-class Indian's financial discipline is systematically drained by corporate micro-charges.
posts.angle: No matter how carefully you calculate your savings, the infrastructure of the transaction is designed to eat the margin.
slides:
Invest ₹1000 — convenience fee.

Sell ₹1000 — brokerage fee.

Check balance — SMS charge.

Move money — UPI MDR.

Your money is still in transit.

Sab chalta hai.
posts.caption: The math always favors the house. 🏦
posts.rank_verdict: Using localized jargon like UPI MDR and ending on a colloquial phrase makes the post collapse outside India.
